meta.description: Watch multiple YouTube videos and Twitch streams at once, on a single screen.

setup.intro: Add YouTube links or Twitch streams, one per line: the empty one at the bottom is always ready for the next. They all start together, muted — you turn the audio on yourself, one at a time. Then you can copy a link to send to anyone: they'll see the same videos.

welcome.title: Welcome to Scrywall 👁️
welcome.body: Lots of videos and streams, all on one screen. Here's how it works in a few steps — you can skip anytime.

links.title: Paste your links
links.body: One YouTube or Twitch link per line. The empty line at the bottom is always ready for the next one, and you can paste many at once.

start.title: Light up the wall
start.body: Press here and the videos all start together, without sound. You turn the audio on yourself, one at a time.

language.title: Your language
language.body: Scrywall speaks 6 languages: switch here whenever you like.

donate.title: A coffee or a beer?
donate.body: The site is free. If you find it useful, you can buy me something from here.

replay.title: Replay the tour
replay.body: If you forget something, the tour is always right here.

welcome.title: Here's your wall
welcome.body: Every video started muted. Let's take a quick look at what you can do from here.

add.title: Add without starting over
add.body: Paste a link here to add a video: the ones already playing won't stop.

tile.title: Every tile is a video
tile.body: Play, pause and seeking are YouTube's and Twitch's own controls: use them right on the video.

head.title: The tile bar
head.body:
🔇 turns on this video's audio and mutes the others.
The gold button enlarges it (the same button, or Esc, shrinks it back).
✎ changes the link, ✕ removes it (you can undo).
Drag the bar onto another tile to swap them.

manage.title: Select and loop
manage.body:
Select: remove several videos in one go.
Loop: YouTube videos restart on their own when they end — turn it off here.

share.title: Share the wall
share.body: Copy a link with all these videos inside: whoever opens it sees exactly the same wall.

home.title: Back to home
home.body: Press the logo to go back to your list of links. The videos keep running: when you come back, you'll find them just as you left them.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.body:
Hover over a video and use:
k play/pause · j / l back/forward 10 s
m audio · , / . small steps

replay.title: Replay the tour
replay.body: Whenever you want a refresher, the tour is always here. Enjoy!
